theory.title: Habla de alimentos, bebidas y comidas
theory.explanation: Aprende los nombres de alimentos y bebidas y habla de lo que comes. Usa el presente simple: “I eat” y “She drinks”; para negar, “I don't eat” y “She doesn't eat”. Usa “some” con nombres plurales o incontables al ofrecer o pedir comida. Para preguntar por disponibilidad, puedes usar “Is there any…?”. Para ofrecer, pregunta “Would you like some…?” y responde “I'd like some…”.
theory.tip: “Food” es comida y “drink” puede significar bebida o la acción de beber. “Some” aparece normalmente en afirmativas y ofrecimientos; “any” en preguntas y negativas. Recuerda la -s de he/she en el presente simple: drinks.

content.audioTranscript: Hello, Sam. Are you hungry? Yes, I am. I would like some rice, please. Would you like chicken or fish? Chicken, please. And some vegetables. Here you are. Would you like some juice? No, thank you. Water is fine. Is there any fruit for dessert? Yes. There are some apples in the fridge. Great! I love fresh fruit. Thank you. This is a lovely meal.
